Quadient

(Euronext Paris: QDT), a global automation platform powering secure and sustainable business connections, announced today it has been named a Leader in the QKS Group SPARK Matrix™: Accounts Payable Automation 2026 report. The SPARK Matrix evaluates accounts payable (AP) automation solution vendors based on technology excellence and customer impact, recognizing providers that deliver strong capabilities, customer value and market vision. According to QKS Group, Quadient's leadership position reflects its ability to deliver innovative, scalable and future-ready AP automation.
“Quadient is well positioned in the AP automation market, combining AI-driven invoice processing, configurable approval workflows, multi-entity support and broad ERP integration capabilities,”
said Sanjeevi Cuddalore Ramachandran, Senior Principal Analyst & Associate Vice President, QKS Group. “

Its emphasis on usability and seamless integration allows finance teams to automate core AP processes, improve processing accuracy, and gain stronger operational visibility without requiring significant disruption to existing financial systems.

The platform’s support for e-invoicing, multilingual and multi-currency environments, together with Quadient’s broader AP and AR automation capabilities, extends its value beyond transactional automation toward more connected financial operations and cash-flow visibility.”

Quadient's unified approach to financial process automation was noted in the report as a key differentiator. Quadient’s software solutions have been unified into the Quadient Suite, accessible via a single point of entry and providing users with one trusted provider and a consistent experience across finance automation and customer communication solutions. As part of the Quadient Suite, the new cash dashboard capability allows for fast visibility of working capital along with AI-powered actionable insights and recommendations across AP and accounts receivable (AR).
"Middle market finance teams often face the same operational and compliance challenges of large enterprises but with fewer resources and leaner teams,"
said Valérie Colin, VP Product & Strategy, Finance Automation at Quadient.

"They need solutions that improve cash flow visibility, help them get control over their spend and accelerate invoices payment and collections, while reducing manual work. By bringing AP and AR automation and AI-powered cash dashboards together under a unified experience, Quadient is helping customers improve efficiency and make better financial decisions. We’re honored that QKS Group recognizes Quadient’s differentiated approach and the outcomes it delivers for our customers.”

helps B2B organizations automate the processing of suppliers’ invoices, approvals, and purchasing activities while supporting a growing number of e-invoicing compliance requirements across European markets. The SPARK Matrix report also recognized Quadient AP’s broad integrations with leading ERP and accounting platforms such as Oracle NetSuite, Sage, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics GP, QuickBooks, Acumatica and Xero.
